annotations.grafana.app/message: Installed by the Grafana Asserts Plugin

panels.title: Highest Timestamp In vs. Highest Timestamp Sent

targets.expr:
clamp_min(
  rate(prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])  
- 
  ignoring (remote_name, url) group_right(instance) rate(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])
, 0)

rate(
  prometheus_remote_storage_samples_in_total{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])
- 
  ignoring(remote_name, url) group_right(instance) (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_succeeded_samples_total{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))
- 
  (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_dropped_samples_total{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_dropped_total{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job=~"$job",service=~"$service", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Rate, in vs. succeeded or dropped [5m]
